defs.def: far away in space or time 遥远的；远处的；久远的

ex.s: At any moment, it seemed, a body of horsemen might be seen breaking out from the black trees, so many weapons might be heard and some distant spot of snow be reddened.
ex.t: 在任何时刻，似乎都可能看到一队骑手从黑黢黢的树林中冲出，如此多的兵刃铿锵声可闻，远处某个雪点可能会被染红。

ex.s: The sacrifice of the Challenger calls to us, reminding us that we must continue to reach for the stars, no matter how distant they might seem.
ex.t: 挑战者号的牺牲在召唤我们，提醒我们必须继续向星空进发，无论它们看起来有多遥远。

ex.s: Do further research if necessary Voyager 1 is the spacecraft most distant from Earth.
ex.t: 如果需要的话做进一步的研究：旅行者1号是离地球最远的航天器。

ex.s: So early one cold winter morning, she set out to a distant town.
ex.t: 于是，在一个寒冷的冬日清晨，她出发前往一个遥远的城镇。

ex.s: The pressures of "time" and "destination" are further blocks to awareness． I encountered many hikers who were headed to a distant camp﹣ground with just enough time to get there before dark． It seldom occurred to them to wander a bit， to take a moment to see what's around them． I asked them what they'd seen． "Oh， a few birds， "they said． They seemed bent on their destinations．
ex.t: 时间和'目的地'的压力是觉悟的进一步障碍。我遇到许多徒步者，他们赶往一个遥远的营地，刚好有足够时间在天黑前到达。他们很少想到要闲逛一会儿，花点时间看看周围有什么。我问他们看到了什么。'哦，几只鸟，'他们说。他们似乎一心奔着目的地。

ex.s: It is hoped that the record will be found by other civilisations on distant planets and help them learn about us.
ex.t: 人们希望这张唱片能被遥远星球上的其他文明发现，并帮助他们了解我们。

ex.s: All participants must address how communication or transportation technology has promoted the quality of life for Americans throughout history． To many people，technology means computers， hand﹣held devices， or vehicles that travel to distant planets． However， technology is also the application of scientific knowledge to solve a problem， touching lives in countless ways．
ex.t: 所有参与者必须阐述通信或交通技术如何在整个历史中提升了美国人的生活品质。对许多人来说，技术意味着电脑、手持设备，或前往遥远行星的飞行器。然而，技术也是运用科学知识解决问题，以无数种方式触动着人们的生活。

defs.def: not like sth else 不相似的；不同的
related to you but not closely 人
not friendly; not wanting a close relationship with sb 不友好的；冷淡的；疏远的

ex.s: However, after I went to high school, somehow I become distant from him.
ex.t: 然而，上高中后，不知怎的我和他疏远了。

defs.def: not paying attention to sth but thinking about sth completely different 心不在焉的；恍惚的；出神的

chunks.cn: 遥远的行星 / 遥远的营地 / 遥远的城镇 / 遥远的斑点
